contestants.biography: Bengali actress, model and entrepreneur who built her career across Bengali, Tamil and Telugu television. She became widely known to Telugu audiences for playing Vedha in Ennenno Janmala Bandham before recently launching her own business venture.
contestants.name: Debjani Modak
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ₹2.75 lakh/week (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Telugu and Tamil film actor formerly credited as Adith Arun, known for films including Katha, Inidhu Inidhu, PSV Garuda Vega, Manasuku Nachindi, Dear Megha and Premadesam.
contestants.name: Thrigun (Adith Arun)
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ₹2.75 lakh/week (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Telugu folk singer from a farming family in Komatikunta village, Suryapet district. She became the first Agnipariksha Season 2 contestant to earn direct entry into the main Bigg Boss Telugu 10 house after an emotional performance as a Raitu Bidda.
contestants.name: Singer Jhansi
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ~₹70,000/week, the commoner rate (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Digital media anchor and interviewer from Rayalaseema known for his interview platform Sudheer Talks, associated with Aadhan Media. He built his audience through YouTube and digital interviews rather than traditional television.
contestants.name: Sudheer Reddy
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ₹1.25 lakh/week (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Actor, model and digital creator known for short films and modelling work, representing the newer generation of contestants who built their following through digital platforms.
contestants.name: Aman Masood
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ~₹70,000/week, the commoner rate (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Television and film actress who built a long career across Kannada and Telugu entertainment, becoming familiar to Telugu viewers through television serials before entering the Bigg Boss house.
contestants.name: Chaitra Rai
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ₹2.5 lakh/week (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Born in Visakhapatnam on May 3, 1986, Ram Prasad became famous through Jabardasth, where his comedy writing and 'Auto' punchlines became his trademark. He began his film career with Josh, ran a medical wholesale business, then returned to Hyderabad as a Jabardasth scriptwriter before moving on screen. His films include Nenu Local, Cinema Choopistha Mava, Khaidi No. 150, Uma Maheswara Ugra Roopasya, Bedurulanka 2012 and The Family Star.
contestants.name: Auto Ram Prasad
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ₹4.5 lakh/week, the highest among currently reported contestants (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Model, short-film actress and emcee, also reported as Shalini Damera, who entered Bigg Boss Telugu 10 through the Agnipariksha selection process.
contestants.name: Shalini Patel
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ~₹70,000/week, the commoner rate (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Telugu film actor known for supporting and negative-shade roles, with his screen identity strongly associated with Temper, the Jr NTR-starrer directed by Puri Jagannadh. His filmography includes Bharat Ane Nenu, Saaho, Pushpa and Double iSmart.
contestants.name: Temper Vamsi
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ₹2 lakh/week (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Model, actress and pageant contestant whose background spans modelling, pageantry and acting. She was among the top 15 Agnipariksha contestants, standing out for her confidence and public-speaking ability.
contestants.name: Shiva Srishti Vyakaranam
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ~₹70,000/week, the commoner rate (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Popular comedy performer, also known as Potti Naresh, who built his identity through Jabardasth and went on to appear across Telugu television comedy programs and entertainment events.
contestants.name: Jabardasth Naresh
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ₹2.5 lakh/week (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Radio jockey, anchor and content creator, also known as RJ Charan Mahadev, who entered Bigg Boss Telugu 10 through Agnipariksha. His radio background gives him strong communication and audience-engagement skills.
contestants.name: RJ Charan
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ~₹70,000/week, the commoner rate (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Telugu actor born Alluri Krishna in Chintalapalli, East Godavari district, best known for playing the lead role in Vinayakudu. He completed a diploma in automobile engineering in Bengaluru, worked in photography and as an assistant director before becoming an established actor. His family's reported historical landholding of roughly 4,500 acres was affected by land-ceiling legislation during Indira Gandhi's era.
contestants.name: Krishnudu
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ₹2 lakh/week (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Actress, model and television anchor born to a Tamil family settled in Hyderabad, known for television shows including Dhee, Jabardasth and Pataas 2. She made her Telugu film debut with Chandamama Kathalu and has since appeared in Lovers and Shaakuntalam.
contestants.name: Varshini Sounderajan
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ₹3.5–₹3.75 lakh/week (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Digital creator, model and influencer from Vijayawada, also known as Rohit Naidu Patnam, who earned his place through Agnipariksha. He drew attention for staying composed during difficult tasks and confrontations in the selection process.
contestants.name: Rohit Naidu
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ~₹70,000/week, the commoner rate (media estimate, not an official figure)

contestants.biography: Television and film actor born in Mysuru, Karnataka, who rose to fame playing Rishi (Rishendra Bhushan) in Guppedantha Manasu after starting his career in modelling and pageantry across Kannada and Telugu television.
contestants.name: Mukesh Gowda
contestants.reportedSalary: Reported ₹3 lakh/week (media estimate, not an official figure)
